title: He shared his umbrella with a stray… 🐶☔
description:
Years ago, a little boy gave a stray puppy his umbrella.
Years later, the old dog still came… and Kachi showed him the way.

In Korea, the magpie is the bird that brings good news 🐦

#Dog #Kindness #Korea #Wholesome #DogLove #shorts
